entries.notes: Subject, tonal centre D; opening eighth-note pickup through the G4 in m. 2, tied from a quarter to the first triplet eighth of beat 2. Endpoint includes the final note's written duration and ties.
Answer, tonal centre A; eighth-note pickup halfway through beat 1 of m. 2 through the half note beginning on beat 2 of m. 3. Endpoint includes the final note's written duration and ties.
Subject, tonal centre D; eighth-note pickup halfway through beat 2 of m. 3 through the half note beginning on beat 3 of m. 4. Endpoint includes the final note's written duration and ties.

analysis.description: Opening subject and answer statements only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Foster's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The opening pickup is measure 0. The complete subject includes its pickup before the main accented entry; each following statement shifts one quarter-note beat later within the bar. Foster describes the bass main accent at m. 3 beat 3; the plotted statement also includes its preceding eighth-note pickup. The first subject final note is tied into a triplet. Manual score transcription of opening subject and answer statements, checked against Dorothy Nell Foster (1973), Chapter IV. Quarter-note units; entry ends include the final note and all its written ties. Excerpts extend through the final subject release when it passes the exposition cadence. No recording timing has been estimated. A short independently engraved subject incipit is included; the source score, thesis prose and chart images are not redistributed.
